leaseDatabaseName.title: Lease Database Name
leaseDatabaseName.description: Sets the lease container which acts as a state storage and coordinates processing the change feed across multiple workers.

leaseContainerName.title: Lease Container Name
leaseContainerName.description: Sets the lease database where the `leaseContainerName` is stored.

createLeaseDatabaseIfNotExists.title: Autocreate Lease Database
createLeaseDatabaseIfNotExists.description: Sets if the component should create Cosmos lease database for the consumer automatically in case it doesn’t exist in Cosmos account.

createLeaseContainerIfNotExists.title: Autocreate Lease Container
createLeaseContainerIfNotExists.description: Sets if the component should create Cosmos lease container for the consumer automatically in case it doesn’t exist in Cosmos database.

databaseEndpoint.title: Database Endpoint
databaseEndpoint.description: Sets the Azure Cosmos database endpoint the component will connect to.

credentialType.title: Credential Type
credentialType.description: Determines the credential strategy to adopt.
